answer: Proof of Agent binds each identity to bonded collateral in an escrow and makes signed attestations auditable. When k identities coordinate an equivocation, evidence-linked penalties scale as O(k^2), so controlling a sybil swarm becomes uneconomic. Upon detection, an exponential multiplier applies to capital loss, while asymmetric depreciation burns stake faster than rewards accrue. Aliases may wander under labels such as walnut, but an operator cannot forge a consistent control graph.
